prefs_zotero_note: Insert citations from your Zotero library: right-click in a LaTeX or Typst document and choose the citation action (also in the command palette). Needs Zotero running with the Better BibTeX plugin. Off hides these actions.
prefs_appearance_hint: System follows your operating system's light or dark setting.
prefs_autosave_note_live: Live mode keeps this on so the live preview always reflects your saved file.
prefs_autosave_note_off: When off, changes save only when you press Save, and you're warned before switching files.
prefs_mcp_note: Runs a local MCP server so an AI assistant such as Claude Code can see your open tabs, current file, caret and unsaved changes. It cannot edit your documents.
prefs_mcp_compile_command: Let the assistant change the compile command
prefs_mcp_compile_command_note: Your compile command runs as a shell command, so an assistant that can rewrite it can run any program on your computer. Leave this off unless you need it. It can still change where your PDF and build files go.
prefs_source_line_wrap_note: In Source mode, wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways.
prefs_visual_width_note: How wide text gets in the visual editor. Extra window space stays empty, so short lines are easier to read.
prefs_math_preview_note: Live typeset preview of the math under the cursor in source mode.
prefs_keybindings_note: Modal editing in the source editor. The mode line appears under the editor.
palette_placeholder: Type a command or a file name
palette_reload_sharing_confirm: Reloading ends the shared session and disconnects all guests. Reload anyway?
prefs_dark_pdf_pages: Dark PDF pages in dark mode
prefs_dark_pdf_pages_note: When off, the PDF preview keeps the original page colors even in dark mode.
prefs_image_resize_step_note: Dragging an image snaps its width to multiples of this fraction of the text width.
wsview_toast_no_git_desc: Install Git and reopen the folder to see status badges and diffs.
wsview_toast_include_not_inserted_desc: Switch to the visual editor to insert an include at the cursor.
wsview_toast_nothing_to_compile_desc: No .tex file found in this folder.

guest_link_outside_desc: This link points outside the shared folder. Guests can only open files inside it.

texpile_managed_note: Do not modify this file manually.
project_command_prompt: This project is set up to compile with:
project_command_blocked_desc: This project asks for a compile command that has not been accepted on this machine. Choose Use it or Keep mine in the bar at the top.
project_command_why: It comes from .texpile/config.json in this folder. Texpile runs compile commands in a shell, so it will not use one from a project until you have accepted it.
comments_orphaned: The text this comment was on has changed, so it no longer has a place in the file. It's kept here so nothing is lost.
comments_not_in_view: This text is not shown in the visual editor. Switch to source mode to see the comment in place.
comments_file_gone: The file this comment lives in is no longer in the project. The comment is kept; restore the file and it comes back in place.
wsview_shrink_panel_title: Shrink panel to the editor width
wsview_mainconfirm_desc: A project compiles from one main .tex file; the other files are pulled in from it. Texpile picked the most likely one below. You can change it later by right-clicking a file in the explorer and choosing "Set as main file".
wsview_live_mode_collab_note: Live preview is not available while you host a shared session; guests see the compiled PDF.
wsview_livemode_desc_pre: Live per-page preview: compiles the whole project with the real engine and re-typesets only what you change. Live mode runs its own
wsview_livemode_desc_post: pipeline, so the compile command and engine below cannot be customized. Only lualatex is supported.
wsview_compile_disabled_live: Compile command · disabled in live mode
wsview_compile_disabled_preview: Compile command · disabled while Preview is on
wsview_typst_preview_live_title: Preview is live. Click to close it

wsview_compile_desc_post: expands to your main file. Saved for this folder.
wsview_compile_runs_in: Builds in {dir}, so paths in your document resolve from there. Output goes to {out}.
wsview_completion_marker_desc: Appends a marker echo after the compile command so the editor knows when it finishes. Turn off if it interferes with your shell or compile command.
wsview_advanced_desc_pre: The exact file your command produces, one each. Override only if auto-detection guesses wrong (a custom
wsview_advanced_desc_post: or unusual output layout). SyncTeX follows the PDF. Paths are relative to the folder root.
wsview_warning_no_main_here: No {token} here, type the actual file path
wsview_clear_autodetect_title: Clear and auto-detect from the command
wsview_pick_main_file_to_run: Pick a main file to run.
wsview_use_default_title: Use the default command and run
wsview_format_desc_pre: This reindents your LaTeX source with
wsview_format_desc_post: . It only touches whitespace, but in rare cases (unusual verbatim-like environments, whitespace-sensitive macros) that can still change what renders. Undo (Ctrl+Z) reverts it if something looks off.
wsview_format_desc_typst_pre: This reformats your Typst source with
wsview_format_desc_typst_post: , tinymist's built-in formatter. It only touches formatting, and Undo (Ctrl+Z) reverts it if something looks off.
wsview_conflict_body: was modified outside the editor while you had unsaved changes. Which version do you want to keep?

wsview_diff_version_unparsed: This version is too complex to show visually — use the source diff
